A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Dabi bartender''' worked at [[Zerria's Bar]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. He was present in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] when [[Mirta Gev]] destroyed the [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] of the serving [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Forre Musa]].
